reference_source_db_observation.chat: GitHub main persistence still PgPool; target migration is pending learning adoption
reference_source_db_observation.pet: SQLite implementation not established by current reference inspection

learning_policy.daily_selection: incremental differences against latest weekly confirmed gap baseline; no daily full comparison
learning_policy.daily_gate: latest applicable rust_ai_chat CI success; no weekly implementation gate for daily teaching
learning_policy.weekly_review: Saturday full comparison, implementation, required tests and commit before formal Day publication; failed gates fixed in weekly work
learning_policy.dry_run: only document corrections addressing user-reported issues; code tests migrations read-only
learning_policy.day_status: daily teaching and weekly formal acceptance recorded separately; no preplanned Day topics
learning_policy.content_preservation: retain original lessons; append necessary implementation at end of section 2
learning_policy.weekly_engineering: separate engineering evidence; never add weekly operations to teaching
learning_policy.phase_transition: entering next phase does not imply learning or functional completion

curriculum.stage_topics: selected from confirmed gaps and daily differences; no preplanned Days

stage_boundary_notifications.trigger: Notify once when entering a new phase by documented progress or calendar boundary; never mark actual learning or functional completion from date alone

curriculum.stage_completion_policy: 階段切換、學習實際完成與功能驗收分別記錄；到期只進入下一階段，不自動標記學習或功能完成。未完成項目在原項目下保留後續工作和驗證，不另建重複項目。
